title: GOLDEN HOUR
tagline: Olive tones. Sculptural forms. A slower coffee ritual.
description: A café concept shaped by olive-green sculptural forms and warm natural light. A rounded ribbed counter and overhead frame create the focal point, while curved upholstered seating, pale textured surfaces and planting give the interior a softer rhythm. Full-height glazing connects the seating area with the trees outside; warm lighting carries the atmosphere into the evening.
role: Concept design and creative direction: spatial idea, atmosphere, colour and finish direction, furniture direction and art direction of the concept visuals. Self-initiated concept study, not a built project.
